name: cn-ai-visibility
title_zh: 五个国产AI搜一遍，你的品牌被引用没
tagline_zh: 在 DeepSeek、Kimi、豆包、通义、文心里查你的品牌露出。不只给排名，还拆每家的引用逻辑。
tagline_en: See if your brand shows up in DeepSeek, Kimi, Doubao, Qwen, and Wenxin. Get per-engine citation logic, visibility.
desc_en: Analyze brand/keyword visibility across 5 Chinese AI search engines (DeepSeek/Kimi/豆包/通义千问/文心一言). Get per-engine citation logic analysis, visibility scoring, and optimization strategies. Use when: checking if your brand appears in AI search results, optimizing content for AI citation, monitoring brand visibility in Chinese AI engines, planning GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategy for Chin
why_zh: 别的工具只查海外引擎，它专攻中国AI搜索，且逐引擎拆引用机制，让你知道该往哪儿使劲，不是笼统一份报告。
why_en: Unlike tools for Western engines, this one dives into Chinese AI search, breaking down each engine's citation logic so you know.
limit_zh: 只覆盖五个指定引擎，不含百度、腾讯元宝等；需联网且目标品牌有中文内容；输出为分析报告，不自动改内容。
limit_en: Covers only the 5 listed engines, not Baidu/Tencent Yuanbao. Needs internet and Chinese content for your brand. Outputs analysis, no auto-edits.
title_en: Check brand visibility across 5 Chinese AI search engines
